# Ojusvi

> Ojusvi is a heartfelt wellness platform for Indian adults 55+ and their families — daily live yoga, meditation, panchang, satsang, gentle games and live Tambola, plus Samvit medicine and health-record tracking, in eight Indian languages.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Ojusvi's wellness philosophy, daily sessions, languages and pricing.
- [Watch Live](/watch): Live and upcoming yoga classes, with access details for members.
- [Download the App](/download-app): Get Ojusvi on iOS and Android.
- [Annual Membership](/pay): Annual membership — ₹2,988 billed once for 12 months (₹249/month).
- [Become an Instructor](/become-an-instructor): Join Ojusvi as a wellness instructor.
- [Instructor Earnings Calculator](/earningcalc): Estimate tentative monthly earnings as an instructor.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How we handle your personal data.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Terms governing the use of Ojusvi.
- [Refund Policy](/refund): Refund terms for bookings and purchases.
- [Security](/security): Our security practices and commitments.
- [Account Deletion](/account-deletion): How to request account deletion.

## Plans

- Lite: ₹99/month, recurring — mobile app only.
- Monthly: ₹349/month, recurring — mobile app and laptop access.
- Annual: ₹2,988 billed once for 12 months (₹249/month) — mobile app and laptop access.
- Every new user gets the first 30 days free, no card needed.
